title: Random survival forest on a 20-item questionnaire predicts all-cause mortality in China
summary: Using 8,355 adults from CHNS and 12,711 from CHARLS, six ML models were compared with Cox regression and a random survival forest performed best. A 20-variable questionnaire model reached C-index 0.86 in internal validation and 0.82, 0.77 and 0.79 for 2-, 9- and 11-year mortality in the external cohort. The predictors are self-reported survey data and the model is not causal.
ai_technology: Random survival forest, best of six machine learning models, on a 20-variable questionnaire
